verdict.rationale: Autumn ships an extensive documented public API (check, track, attach, multiAttach, createSchedule, import, trackTokens, webhooks, etc.) with clear reference docs and SDK examples, plus a CLI (atmn) and MCP server for AI-native interaction, giving programmatic control over billing/entitlements. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probed and returned 404 on all candidate paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API usage beyond vendor docs.
